name: Adzviser Shopify
description:
Connect your Shopify data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files — Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about orders, revenue, and average order value. Compare products and sales channels, dig into customer and order trends, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's results or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser Shopify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser Shopify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://shopify.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser Shopify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Shopify provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_shopify, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser Shopify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser Shopify in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser Shopify MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser Shopify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser Shopify is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
